title: feat(console): an app's docs page has one navigation — the docs column — with the path to its book and the previous and next article
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCS24S2hYG3SFdUpRMkrGmE)_

Part of #35424

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWcCSnzHX9bYADvAVH · Area: b1-CX

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：在应用里打开一篇文档，左边不再有应用菜单，只剩文档自己的一栏（顶部「← 返回〈应用〉」、搜索、这个应用的全部手册、底部「全部文档 →」）；只有一条顶栏「〈应用〉 / 文档」；正文 720 px、15 px；「本页目录」随滚动高亮；文末有上一篇和下一篇；流程图可放大。应用的文档首页、空手册和找不到的页面顶部也有「← 返回〈应用〉」。
- 为什么：#35424 指出同屏三套导航、两条顶栏、标题被截断、没有上一篇和下一篇、正文太窄。
- 最坏情况：只影响显示。某个文档页如果漏了返回入口，读者只能用顶栏的应用切换器或浏览器后退；撤回这个 PR 即恢复原样。
- 需要 Sales 做的：无。「全部文档」页（第 6–9 项）是下一个 PR。

## What changes

The reading page half of #35424 (its items 1–5, design figure 25). The "All docs" page (items 6–9, figure 26) is the next PR.

Inside an app, a documentation page (`/apps/<app>/docs/…`):

1. **No app menu beside the docs.** `ConsoleLayout` mounts no `UnifiedSidebar` on an app's docs routes (`isAppDocsPath`, beside `isRecordPagePath`), and the app bar draws no sidebar toggle there (its slot is held empty, as off an app). The left column is the docs' own (`DocsNav`), headed by 「← Back to <app>」 (the app the route segment addresses, by the label the app bar shows). Every other docs page inside an app (the app's docs index, a book with no articles, a book or doc not found) carries the same link at its top (`DocShell` draws `AppDocsBackLink`; the reader turns it off because its column has it), so no docs page is left without a way back.
2. **One bar.** The app bar stays and reads 「<app> / Documentation」 (a `docs` crumb in `AppHeader`, from `help.documentation`). `DocShell` draws no bar of its own inside an app, so the separate 「Documentation / <title>」 strip is gone. Above the article, the path names the book: Documentation › <book>, both links.
3. **Every book of the package in the column.** The current book open, the others folded, each with its article count; long titles wrap instead of truncating (`BookSidebar`); a 「Search docs」 field filters the column by article title and summary; 「All documentation →」 at its foot (the existing `help.allDocs` key). (The full-text search of all docs is item 9, the next PR.)
4. **「On this page」 marks the section being read** as the page scrolls (`useActiveHeading`: the last heading at or above the bar plus the headings' scroll margin; the last one once the page is scrolled to its end), and the article ends with its book's **previous / next article** cards; at either end of the book the empty side says so.
5. **Article 720 px wide at 15 px** (was ~590 px at 14 px). A Mermaid diagram gets an 「Enlarge」 control that opens it full size in a dialog: `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` adds `MermaidEnlargeContext`, which the reader provides; with no provider (every other markdown surface) a diagram renders exactly as before. The dialog's copy renames the render-id prefix (root id, scoped styles, markers), so no id appears twice while it is open.

The portal reader (`/docs/<book>/<doc>`) gets the same column, path and pager; its own header bar stays until the next PR gives that page the top bar.

`@object-ui/app-shell` exports `matchAppBySegment` and `useServedAppLabel` for the back link. Twelve new `help.*` keys in all 11 shipped locales (real text in each).

## Why

The maintainer's topic #34571, card #35424: three navigations side by side on one screen (the app's 30-odd menu entries, the book's contents, "On this page"), a second bar under the app bar, the other books of the app reachable only through the app menu, truncated titles, no previous / next, no current section, a narrow 14 px body.

## Verification

- Browser, against the showcase app (`objectstack dev --fresh`, console on vite), zh-CN, 1440 × 900, `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs/manual/showcase_tour_ui`:
  - before: app menu drawn, two bars, article 592 px, body 14 px, no current section;
  - after: no app menu (`[data-sidebar=sidebar]` absent), one bar reading 「功能展示 / 文档」, article 720 px, body 15 px; scrolled to the end, 「本页目录」 marks 「Branding」 and the pager shows 上一篇 Tour · Data / 下一篇 Tour · Automation; 32 px below the pager at the end of the scroll (no blank screen; it was 24 px on `main` here too, so the hosted environment's blank screen was not reproduced on `main`).
  - At 900 px the column folds into the disclosure above the path, as the book sidebar did.
  - Screenshots (before / after) are kept with the card's evidence for the reviewer.
- Tests (new pins in the existing harnesses):
  - `docs-portal.test.tsx` — the in-app reader: no bar of its own; back link and 「All documentation」; the path's two links; the pager at the first and last article; the search narrowing the column and its no-match line; a package with two books lists both (current open, other folded, unfolds on click) and no other package's book. The app's docs index and a not-found book lead back to the app; the reader carries the link once.
  - `docs-reading.test.ts` — reading order (a doc placed twice counted once, links and separators skipped), neighbours, the filter (title, summary, case, non-Latin), `pickActiveHeading`.
  - `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx` — docs routes draw no app menu and keep the app bar; other routes keep the menu; `isAppDocsPath` table.
  - `AppHeader.systemBreadcrumbs-10969.test.tsx` — 文档 / Documentation crumb on the docs routes; the empty toggle slot there, the toggle elsewhere.
  - `Mermaid.enlarge-35424.test.tsx` — the control and dialog with a provider (the dialog's copy under its own ids), nothing without one.
  - `DocPage.docLinkBasename-12686.test.tsx` — its portal control now reads every 「Documentation」 link (the header's and the path's); both name the portal.
- `vitest`: `apps/console`, `packages/plugin-markdown`, `packages/i18n` in full: 1,399 files, 5,458 tests passed (one red on the first run, `zh-hant-generated.test.ts`: two zh-Hant strings were hand-written; regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`, now green). `packages/app-shell`: the 165 test files that import `AppHeader`, `ConsoleLayout`, the new exports or the package index, 1,458 tests passed (its full 2,356 files outran a 50-minute local budget; CI runs them). `tsc` for the four packages and `eslint` over the changed files: 0 errors, no new warnings.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main` and the four open PRs sharing the locale files (#35918, #35968, #35984, #35994).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @object-ui/plugin-markdown exports MermaidEnlargeContext and MermaidEnlargeText; @object-ui/i18n adds 12 help.* keys; nothing removed
Metadata-protocol: none

Follow-ups (not in this PR): items 6–9 of #35424 (the "All docs" page: top bar, grouped by app, localized subtitle and counts, system packages named and shown to admins only, search all docs) — next PR, new thread.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
